race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
race.analyst_verdict: EXCEPTIONALLY and Silver Kiss have had a few chances but look the pair to focus on, with Aidan O'Brien's filly taken to get off the mark down in class. Harita might be the pick of the newcomers.

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.analyst_verdict: EXCEPTIONALLY and Silver Kiss have had a few chances but look the pair to focus on, with Aidan O'Brien's filly taken to get off the mark down in class. Harita might be the pick of the newcomers.

races.title: Punchestown is Back Maiden
races.analyst_verdict: Preference is for NOBLE EXHIBIT, who was a promising third on debut at the Curragh last month and looks sure to improve for the step up in trip. Francillon and Dancinginthecity rate the principal dangers.

races.title: Punchestown Jumps Opener October 13th Handicap
races.analyst_verdict: The assessor has been very fair with ZARAAHMANDO dropping him 2 lb on the back of another very solid effort so's selected to get off the mark for the season. 3-y-os Flash of Fire (starting out for an excellent yard) and Motta Alta have bigger efforts in them so must command respect.

races.title: Punchestown Premiere Weekend November 21st & 22nd Race
races.analyst_verdict: MINELLA ROCKETT is thriving at present and is taken to extend his winning sequence to 4, perhaps at the expense of lightly-raced 4-y-o Queen of The Bogs, who shaped well on her reappearance at Fairyhouse in June. Puppet Master has opened his account over hurdles since last seen on the Flat, so it's reasonable to expect a better showing on return to this code.

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Median Auction Maiden
races.analyst_verdict: BACK STRAIGHT made a promising start when splitting a pair of Aidan O'Brien's better 3-y-os here 12 months ago and is the obvious call fitted with a tongue tie in the hope all is well. Xirivella could be the danger, ahead of Fleur de Provence.

races.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.analyst_verdict: SWEET BABY ZOU looks capable of adding to her sole success before the season is out judged on her last 2 performances under her young claimer and gets the vote in a tricky handicap. Galway winner Rest Your Mind, Lady Arwen and Areana are a trio of the other likely contenders.

races.title: Festival 2027 on Sale Soon Handicap (0 60) (Div 1)
races.analyst_verdict: SPIRITOFTHEDAWN clearly has something in hand of her basement mark judged on her fine effort at Navan on her handicap debut and won't be far away again if building on that performance. Rampage is a big danger after his Gowran near-miss, with Lohengrin another to consider after his narrow defeat at Laytown.

races.title: Festival 2027 on Sale Soon Handicap (0 60) (Div 2)
races.analyst_verdict: BELIEVE BELIEVE came close to landing a gamble at Gowran on his return in May, and although he's been absent again since, it's likely he has a race or two in him and looks the way to go. Medieval Night, Pinball Wizard and Miss Americana are dangers.

runner.owner_name: Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith
runner.analyst_comment: Half-sister to top-class City of Troy. Yet to get off the mark after 4 starts but resumed progress ridden with more restraint when 2¼ lengths fourth of 10 to Sea of Rain in 1m Curragh Group 3 17 days ago. That form isn't looking great but she's well up to winning a maiden on what she's shown.
